about: The directories runAllTests deliberately does NOT search for suites, each with its reason. Every entry is printed as SKIP by -list and by every run, so a skipped directory is never silently absent. An entry is either a directoryName (skipped wherever a directory of that name appears) or a directoryPath relative to the tree root (skipped there only; it must exist, or discovery refuses the stale entry by name).

exclusionList.reason: third-party packages: their test-*.js files are the packages' own, not this tree's suites
retired code kept for its history: its suites test modules that no longer run in this tree
